mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer spending, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the real personal consumption expenditures series (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.5 percent signals stronger manufacturing output, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).
